tei:div.tei:p: dkar chagabasdu sgrig gsal bshad/....................................1-2rngog lo chen po'i rnam thar mdor bsdus/.............................1-4mtshan nyid kyi chos zhes bya ba tshad ma rnam nges kyi bsdus don gyi dkar chag bzhugs so/ /

ka1 klad kyi don bshad pa/......................................1ka2 gzhung gi don bstan pa/.....................................3kha1 dgos 'brel ngag bshad pa/..................................3kha2 bstan bcos kyi rang bzhin bshad pa/.............................15dang po/ mngon sum gyi le'u bshad pa/...............................15kha1 dbang po mngon sum bshad pa/................................15kha2 yid kyi mngon sum bshad pa/.................................23kha3 rang rig mngon sum bshad pa/................................24kha4 rnal 'byor mngon sum bshad pa/...............................26gnyis pa/ rang don rjes dpag gi le'u bshad pa/.........................31gsum pa/ gzhan don rjes dpag gi le'u bshad pa/........................43ka3 mjug gi don bstan pa/....................................52༄༅/ /tshad ma rnam nges kyi dka' 'grel rnam bshad kyi dkar chag bzhugs so/ /................................53ka1 klad kyi don bstan pa/.....................................53ka2 gzhung gi don bstan pa/....................................53kha1 rtsom pa la 'jug pa'i yan lag bstan pa/...........................53kha2 bstan bcos kyi rang bzhin bshad pa/.............................64ga1 tshad ma spyi'i mtshan nyid bshad pa/...............................64ga2 tshad ma spyi'i dbye ba bshad pa/.................................83ga3 grangs nges bshad pa/.....................................87le'u dang po/ mngon sum bshad pa/................................105nga1 mngon sum yang dag bshad pa/................................105ca1 mngon sum spyi'i mtshan nyid bshad pa/............................105ca2

mtshan gzhi so sor bshad pa/................................113cha1 dbang po mngon sum bshad pa/...............................113cha2 yid kyi mngon sum bshad pa/................................132cha3 rang rig mngon sum bshad pa/...............................136cha4 rnal 'byor mngon sum bshad pa/..............................145nga2 mngon sum ltar snang bshad pa/...............................149nga3 tshad ma dang 'bras bu bshad pa/...............................150le'u gnyis pa/ rang don rjes dpag bshad pa/..........................166nga1 sgras brjod rigs tsam gyi dbye ba mdor bstan pa/......................166nga2 rang don rjes dpag bye brag tu bshad pa/...........................171ca1 rang don rjes dpag gi mtshan nyid bshad pa/.........................171ca2 rang don rjes dpag gi gtan tshigs gtan la dbab pa/.................. 174cha1 gtan tshigs kyi mtshan nyid bshad pa/............................183cha2 mtshan gzhi'i dbye ba bshad pa/................................204ja1 gtan tshigs spyi'i dbye ba bshad pa/.............................203nya1 ma dmigs pa'i rtags bshad pa/..............................218nya2 rang bzhin gyi rtags bshad pa/...............................234nya3 'bras bu'i gtan tshigs bshad pa/.............................245ja2 khyab pa'i rtsa ba 'brel ba nges pa la ltos par sgrub pa/....................264le'u gsum pa/ gzhan don rjes dpag bshad pa/.........................278nga1 sgrub ngag bshad pa/......................................278ca1 sgrub ngag yang dag bshad pa/.................................278cha1 rjod byed ngag gi rang bzhin bshad pa/............................278cha2

brjod bya don gyi rang bzhin bshad pa/............................282ca2 sgrub ngag ltar snang bshad pa/.................................351nga2 sun 'byin bstan pa/.....................................358kha3 bshad pa mthar phyin pa'i don bstan pa/...........................358ka3 mjug gi don bstan pa/...................................359༄༅/ /shes rab snying po'i rgya cher 'grel gyi bshad pa/................ 360༄༅/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i man ngag gi bstan bcos mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan 'grel pa dang bcas pa'i dka' 'grel rin po che'i sgron me zhes bya ba'i dkar chag bzhugs so/ /...............369 ka1 klad kyi don bstan pa/....................................369ka2 gzhung gi don bstan pa/...................................369kha1 bshad pa la 'jug pa'i yan lag bshad pa/.........................369kha2 bstan bcos kyi rang bzhin bshad pa/............................375ga1 lus rnam par gzhag pa/...................................375ga2 yan lag rgyas par bshad pa/................................380skabs dang po/ rnam mkhyen bshad pa/...............................380skabs gnyis pa/ lam shes bshad pa/..............................417skabs gsum pa/ gzhi shes bshad pa/..............................429skabs bzhi pa/ rnam kun mngon rdzogs bshad pa/.........................435skabs lnga pa/ rtse mo mngon par rtogs pa bshad pa/........................457skabs drug pa/ mthar gyis pa'i sbyor ba bshad pa/........................471skabs bdun pa/ skad cig ma'i sbyor ba bshad pa/.........................473skabs brgyad pa/ 'bras bu chos sku bshad pa/...........................474kha3

bshad pa mthar phyin pa'i don bshad pa/...........................476ka3 mjug gi don bstan pa/...................................477༄༅/ /rngog blo ldan shes rab kyis mdzad pa'i mdo sde rgyan gyi bsdus don gyi dkar chag bzhugs so/ /..................................478 ka1 klad kyi don bstan pa/....................................478ka2 gzhung gi don bstan pa/...................................478kha1 bstan bcos la 'jug pa'i yan lag bshad pa/.......................478kha2 bstan bcos kyi rang bzhin bshad pa/............................482le'u dang po/ gleng gzhi bshad pa/.................................482le'u gnyis pa/ theg pa chen po sgrub pa/..............................484le'u gsum pa/ skyabs 'gro bshad pa/..............................495le'u bzhi pa/ rigs bshad pa/..................................498le'u lnga pa/ sems bskyed bshad pa/................................501le'u drug pa/ sgrub pa bshad pa/..................................503le'u bdun pa/ de kho na nyid bshad pa/...............................505le'u brgyad pa/ mthu bshad pa/..................................507le'u dgu pa/ yongs su smin pa bshad pa/.............................507le'u bcu pa/ byang chub bshad pa/.................................508le'u bcu gcig pa/ mos pa bshad pa/..............................515le'u bcu gnyis pa/ yongs su 'tshol ba bshad pa/........................518le'u bcu gsum pa/ chos ston pa bshad pa/............................526le'u bcu bzhi pa/ sgrub pa bshad pa/................................527le'u bco lnga pa/ gdams ngag rjes su bstan pa bshad pa/

....................527le'u bcu drug pa/ thabs dang ldan pa'i las bshad pa/......................529le'u bcu bdun pa/ phar phyin dang bsdu ba bshad pa/........................530le'u bco brgyad pa/ mchod pa dang bsten pa dang tshad med bshad pa/................533le'u bcu dgu pa/ byang chub phyogs mthun bshad pa/........................535le'u nyi shu pa/ yon tan bshad pa/.................................541le'u nyer gcig pa/ sbyor ba dang mthar thug bshad pa/......................543ka3 mjug gi don bstan pa/...................................544༄༅/ /theg pa chen po rgyud bla ma'i bsdus don zhes bya ba'i dkar chag bzhugs so/ /.........................................545 ka1 klad kyi don bstan pa/....................................545ka2 gzhung gi don bstan pa/...................................545kha1 lus rnam par gzhag pa/...................................545kha2 yan lag rgyas par bshad pa/................................566ga1 'bras bu dkon mchog gi don bshad pa/...........................566ga2 de bzhin gshegs pa'i snying po'i skabs bshad pa/......................580ga3 byang chub kyi skabs bshad pa/................................601ga4 yon tan gyi skabs bshad pa/................................609ga5 'phrin las kyi skabs bshad pa/...............................613ga6 phan yon gyi skabs bshad pa/................................623kha3 bstan bcos mthar phyin pa'i don bstan pa/.........................624ka3 mjug gi don bstan pa/...................................625༄༅/ /dbus mtha'i bsdus don gyi dkar chag bzhugs so/ /.........................................626
